summary: The new `sInfCharacteristicWeight` definition is exposed with no `_def` restatement and no greatest-lower-bound rule, so downstream it is opaque outside the negative-definite hypothesis, and its own proof has to unfold it by name. One single-use completed-square helper is public where it should be private.
